_doc: Single source of truth for the shared parts of the site. See README.md. Per-year fields: description (og/meta text), credit / credit_bottom (inner HTML of the credit slots), video (badge on card), thumb (source image for the card thumbnail, relative to public/), thumb_crop (e.g. 3:2, centre crop), thumb_fit (cover; default contain), card_bg (card background; auto-filled by --images when missing, set by hand to override), collage (cover|contain: include the thumbnail in the home share image).
